transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Well, mostly I came in because I’m just tired in a way that doesn’t really make sense. I mean, I can sleep fine, and I'm keeping up with everything at work, but... I just feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even gets going.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yes, I suppose so. For a long time now, there's just been this... gray, flat feeling most days. It's not exactly a sharp sadness, just flat. Even the things I used to really look forward to—like going fishing, tending to my tomatoes out back, or taking in a church concert—they just feel like items on a checklist now instead of something I actually enjoy doing.
Have you noticed a lack of energy or feel fatigued most days, even after getting enough rest?

Yeah, like I mentioned a minute ago, that's really the main thing. I get plenty of sleep, and I'm keeping up with my work at the office just fine, but... yeah, I still just feel like I'm running on a low battery right from the start of the day. It just doesn't make sense to be this tired when I know I'm getting enough rest.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like fishing or going to concerts, to the point where they feel like chores instead of things you look forward to?

Yeah, like I was saying a minute ago, that's exactly it. I still do them sometimes, but... there's just no joy in it anymore. Whether it's the fishing or going to the concerts, it really just feels like going through the motions now. Just another thing to get done rather than something I actually want to do.
Doctor: Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Well, like I mentioned earlier, yeah, it's definitely been there. It's not just the last two weeks, though... it's been a long time. Just that same gray, flat feeling most of the time. Like I said about the fishing and the tomatoes... it's all just a checklist now.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the gray mood and lack of enjoyment in activities?

It's been quite a while now. I'd say... well, it really started when I got pulled back into full operational leadership at work. That was about two years and four months ago. So, yeah, it's been going on ever since then.
Have you had these symptoms of low mood and loss of interest continuously for at least the past two years?

Yes, exactly. Like I was just saying, it's been going on continuously since I was pulled back into full operational leadership. That was about two years and four months ago... so, yeah, definitely for at least the past two years.

latest_inference.note: The duration of symptoms (over two years) and the persistent, low-grade depressive symptoms point to dysthymia (F34.1), ruling out the major depressive disorder subtypes (F32.0, F32.1, F32.2) and recurrent depressive disorder (F33.0, F33.1, F33.2) which do not fit the chronic and less severe presentation.
